recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied base Measure example work without importing the Quality Measure IG continuous-variable profile into core; any future profile-specific changes should remain in the QM IG unless CQI makes a new final decision.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive CQI change request for R6 asking to add a continuous variable Measure example from the Quality Measure IG to the base Measure resource and add narrative references to the QM IG for additional Measure examples, while not moving the continuous-variable Measure profile into core FHIR.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3938 applied the issue: commit 6a646a3a8c added source/measure/measure-EXM55-FHIR.xml and listed it in source/measure/list-Measure-examples.xml, commit 615ce38d21 added the contained Library and switched the Measure to reference it, and merge commit 3a8e3d8a23 brought the application into the repository. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-24629 existed on the combined branch.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists measure=Measure, so the Measure examples and examples header under source/measure are current build inputs. FHIR-49945 was already represented on the combined branch and later touched Measure examples cleanup, including the EXM55 file, but did not correct the EXM55 group linkId, measure-observation input reference, or the missing QM IG examples reference. The Quality Measure IG source is R4/profile-based, while current R6 base Measure has native group linkId and inputPopulationId elements; inputPopulationId is defined as the id of the population element that provides the input.
reconciliation: Changed source/measure/measure-EXM55-FHIR.xml so group.linkId uses the proper value attribute and the measure observation inputPopulationId references the actual measure-population linkId. Updated source/measure/measure-examples-header.xml to point readers to the Quality Measure Implementation Guide for additional computable measure examples.
source_changes: source/measure/measure-EXM55-FHIR.xml: corrected the group linkId attribute from value- to value and changed inputPopulationId to primary-exm55-measure-population so it references an existing population linkId.
source/measure/measure-examples-header.xml: added a Quality Measure Implementation Guide link for additional computable Measure examples.
